purpose: Minimal machine-first entrypoint for rehydrating XRBitcoinCash project context without loading the full history first.
scope_boundary: This repository is an external continuity/context layer. It improves project-state recovery and routing; it does not alter model weights or create persistent internal model state.
load_order: ai-memory.json and memory/synapse-map.json for task-specific facts/routes
canonical contract for security-sensitive, policy-sensitive, conflicting or incomplete evidence

safety_invariants: Wallet connection is authorization only; do not create a transaction merely to connect.
Browser Connect invokes XRBCXamanStandard.authorizeAndWarm() immediately from the deliberate user gesture while read-only backend/XRPL readiness starts in parallel.
Browser authorization uses one explicit attempt identity/generation guard; late responses from cancelled attempts are obsolete.
Expose Cancel / restart Xaman in the same visible wallet surface while browser authorization is active.
The current browser authorization maximum is 180 seconds; timeout invalidates the attempt, clears local signing authorization, performs bounded SDK logout and returns to an explicit Connect state.
No automatic reconnect/retry or replacement authorization is created by timers/countdowns.
Inside a Xaman xApp, use the account supplied by the xApp runtime; do not invoke unsupported browser OAuth/authorization there.
A remembered public XRPL address is not proof of current Xaman signing readiness.
Disconnect/reset preserves already-created or ambiguous signing-request guards.
No Xaman transaction payload during backend warm-up.
Exactly one Xaman payload per deliberate final transaction intent.
Ambiguous payload creation is reconciled; do not auto-create a replacement payload.
Final transaction success requires validated XRPL evidence, tesSUCCESS, signer/account equality, and critical-field comparison.
consistency_rules: latest_savepoint.record and ai-memory.json latest_savepoint must refer to the same active savepoint.
Repository evidence outranks cached conversation or indexed-search assumptions.
Before any code write, verify the exact source repository, branch, file, and current head.
Topic routes are context pointers, not authority.
Do not delete historical human-readable checkpoints during the machine-first transition.
Active graph node, NEXT_RUN, bootstrap, ai-memory and latest record must agree; validate with node scripts/validate-memory.mjs.
Publish all current pointers in one atomic non-force memory update; retain historical checkpoints.
Do not infer live success from a green badge or a historical model capability label.

transition.target: machine-primary continuity artifacts with human-readable history retained as fallback/evidence
transition.promotion_rule: Move a memory category to machine-primary only after repeated session bootstraps resolve the same source-of-truth, latest savepoint, invariants, and task routing without contradiction.
